Settled market PnL -$48.6k (locked pair spread -$90.2k, residual +$41.6k). Taker fees -$157.3k, taker rebate +$96.7k (61% of fees), maker rebate +$8.7k: incentives are 92% of its total PnL.

roc.detail: peak capital at risk $64.9k; 30-day PnL $56.4k; 87% per month

backtest.detail: public-data maker -17.7% (p>0.99 for loss); fitted taker rule +2.6% (p=0.34); its own trading is loss-making before rebates (-$48.6k in 30 days)

replicable.detail: profit exists only above the Platinum rebate tier: at 0% -$40.3k/month, Gold -$12.0k, Platinum +$10.0k; tiers need $1M-$10M of 30-day weighted volume

persistence.detail: last 30 days significant (p=0.034); no significant decline (daily mean $3.5k -> $1.9k, p=0.09) or trend (p=0.53); profit depends entirely on the Taker Rebate Program, in force today but changeable by Polymarket

reasons: The strategy loses money on trading; the profit is Polymarket's fee rebate.
A replicator without the top rebate tier would lose money.
